summary: Phase 149O.20L.7O.3W.1R.2A (Runtime Invocation Human Principal Authentication and Authority Provenance Architecture) is a read-only architecture/contract-design phase that resolved N2's contract-insufficiency finding from Phase 149O.20L.7O.3W.1R.2 by investigating the full human-identity universe (OS username, Git identity, PCAE session/agent identity, Typed Authority Model, CHGR, Interactive Workflow Confirmation, HATP hardware signing) and recommending a two-tier authentication architecture (RIHAC-001 v1.1 + RIASC-001 v1.1 + a new companion Human-Principal Authentication contract, over a replaceable mechanism layer with hardware-backed FIDO2 approval as the primary v1 mechanism, reusing HATP's existing but currently non-functional PrincipalRecord/SignerRecord registry pattern). This mechanism is explicitly required to resist the mandatory same-user autonomous-agent threat, which no OS-username, Git-identity, session-identity, TAM, CHGR, or Interactive Workflow mechanism can satisfy. No src/pcae file was modified. No test file was modified. No frozen contract (RIHAC-001, RIASC-001, PBRD-001, RDGO-001, RPAC-001) was modified. No B1/B7/N1 repair was performed. No human authentication mechanism was implemented. No biometric, keychain, or PAM API was accessed. No hardware key was touched or created. No HATP component was invoked. No Runtime Enforcement component was activated. No Shell Gate component was activated. No POL-005 rule was relaxed. No runtime process was spawned. No network, provider, or credential access occurred. No execution was activated. No version, tag, release, or v0.4.3 state was changed. No stopped article was read, resumed, or published. No private research repository was inspected or modified. Runtime remains Observed/observe/unavailable for Phase 149O.20L.7O.3W.1R.2A.
